description: Aggregates of the latest daily run over the whole official MCP registry: how many servers answer and why the rest do not, token cost percentiles and the exact-to-estimate ratio, how servers authenticate, protocol versions, transports, the heaviest servers and the biggest publishers. Use it for the state of the registry as a whole; use lookup_server or search_servers for one server. No input; the answer is a few kilobytes of JSON.
name: registry_summary

authKinds.description: Servers that need auth, per kind of access: oauth-dcr, oauth, token, unknown

authSchemes.description: Servers that need auth, per WWW-Authenticate scheme

claudeTokens.description: Exact Claude counts: model, counted, refused, median, p90, p99, max, histogram, ratioToEstimate

ok.description: Servers that answered initialize and tools/list

protocols.description: Alive servers per negotiated protocol version

toolsTokens.description: o200k_base estimate: median, p90, p99, max, total

title: Registry summary
